title: Bayes posterior and sequential updates
summary: Turn a prior and a likelihood into a posterior over hypotheses, and update it one observation at a time without underflow.

mutants.no_normalize: Returns prior times likelihood and does not divide by the evidence, so the result does not sum to 1.
mutants.forgets_prior: Normalizes the likelihood alone and ignores the prior.
mutants.product_first: Multiplies all the likelihoods together before it normalizes, which underflows to zero for many observations.
mutants.in_place: Multiplies the prior array in place, so the caller's prior changes.
mutants.no_zero_check: Divides by an evidence of zero and returns NaN.
